scope_qualifier: ordered fcc intermetallic surfaces, composition-level granularity, demo-level free-energy corrections (+0.24 eV for H*, +3.2 eV for OH*/O*)

E1_scaling_matrix.literature_comparison: Literature OH*/H* scaling slopes are ~0.5-1; our H->OH Theil-Sen slope is 1.38 but with R2=0.07 (n=229, small OH* tier) -- direction consistent, magnitude above the band and statistically weak. OH->O slope 1.74 (R2=0.81) matches the well-established O*-OH* scaling (~1.7-2 directional).

E2_gap_verdict.data_convention: label-based (measured shared compositions, no model predictions)

HER_x_ORR.verdict: PHYSICAL GAP: d_min = 1.951 eV is 17.7x the model resolution (0.11 eV); the empty HER x ORR intersection is NOT a resolution limit -- it is a physical fact within the dataset coverage (ordered fcc intermetallic surfaces, composition-level granularity, demo-level free-energy corrections (+0.24 eV for H*, +3.2 eV for OH*/O*)).

HER_x_OER.verdict: PHYSICAL GAP: d_min = 0.888 eV is 8.1x the model resolution (0.11 eV); the empty HER x OER intersection is NOT a resolution limit -- it is a physical fact within the dataset coverage (ordered fcc intermetallic surfaces, composition-level granularity, demo-level free-energy corrections (+0.24 eV for H*, +3.2 eV for OH*/O*)).

E3_ladder.hypothesis_check: NOT SUPPORTED: Spearman rho(MAE, n_atoms)=-0.12 over 15 adsorbates
E3_ladder.note: Over all 15 adsorbates MAE does NOT rise with atom count (negative result, reported as-is); within the large tier the ladder is driven by dissociated dimers (2H/2N/2O): MAE ~ 0.19*n_atoms + 0.03 (r=0.69).

E4_pooled_vs_separate.verdict: SEPARATE WINS: pooled-with-one-hot wins fair contract on 2/15 adsorbates; mean delta(sep-pooled)=-0.0273 eV. The data-sharing benefit is largely absorbed by the adsorbate indicator feature (or offset by cross-adsorbate interference); per-adsorbate models remain the reference.

E5_escape_angle_redflags.interpretation: Of the 20 compositions nearest to the HER x ORR ideal point, 16 (80%) carry at least one red flag (radioactivity / toxicity / strong oxophilicity / LOEO leaching) and 100% lie outside the OH* training set (model extrapolation). "Escape angle = untrusted angle": the compositions that escape the scaling-line gap are simultaneously model-untrusted (extrapolated) and materials-unstable -- double warning.
